fact: The ARMP states that the national e-GP platform Telemo entered a new phase of use in September 2026, with companies registering on it and the system described by its Director General as in place and under way.
Guinea rolled out TELEMO, a national e-procurement platform from a Guinea-Rwanda South-South partnership, officially launched on 17 November 2025 on behalf of the Head of State, per Smart Africa.
